presentation.label: RETRIG REC
presentation.summary: LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig, with the velocity and timing you played.
presentation.overview: Stock records a retrig hold as one trig and a few locks that its held-note erase mostly removes, so what plays back is not what you played. With Retrig Rec every hit of a roll, from RTRG + pad or a pad set to ALWAYS ON, records a real trig at the velocity it sounded and the time it sounded, quantize live rec on or off. Rates faster than a step record a trig with a step retrig, because a step holds one trig. There is nothing to set.
highlights: One real trig for each hit at 1/16 and slower, velocity following pressure.
ALWAYS ON pads record the same way.
Retrig hits keep played timing even with quantize live rec on; plain pad hits still quantize.
Faster rates record a step retrig, and the RETRIG menu's VEL.CUR goes with it.
Works beside Retrig Grid, recording the grid it plays.
usage: Hold RECORD and press PLAY, hold RTRG and hold a pad, varying the pressure.
Let go and leave LIVE RECORDING: the roll plays back as played.
In GRID RECORDING, edit the roll's trigs one by one.

access.location: LIVE RECORDING, with RTRG + pad or a pad set to ALWAYS ON. No menu or page of its own.
steps: Hold RTRG, then hold a pad and vary the pressure.

limitations: Rates faster than a step record one velocity for each trig's hits, or VEL.CUR's fade.
Micro timing has 24 units a step.
A roll started before LIVE RECORDING can miss hits.
Not tested on a unit; pad pressure was scripted in rytm-emu.

claims: ui:RETRIG menu step writes in LIVE RECORDING

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: rytm-emu c5732f0 only, scripted pressure: 1/8, 1/12, 1/16, 1/20, 1/24, 1/32, ALWAYS ON, quantize on and off, track speed 2x and 1/2x, beside Retrig Grid. Not tested on a unit. See TESTING.md.
